evidence: candidate.md:133 omits assertions for per-run reviewer and cache_write_tokens, and for totals' five token sums, cost_usd and usage_incomplete_runs.
candidate.md:138 nevertheless claims V-003 verifies R-001.C1–C4.
cmd/shogun/stats.go:103–115 distinguishes damaged-run spend lower bounds from usage lower bounds; the fixture in cmd/shogun/stats_test.go:32–49 always includes both unknown usage and damage.
findings.problem: S-002 does not establish R-001.C2 and R-001.C4. Missing or incorrectly mapped JSON token totals and cost would pass every specified assertion. Likewise, setting both lower-bound flags permanently true would pass the sole fixture.
findings.requested_change: Extend S-002 to assert the omitted required fields and exact token/cost totals, including presence of zero-valued fields. Add focused cases with complete usage and with incomplete or unknown usage but no damaged runs, verifying the distinct lower-bound flags.

summary: The implementation approach matches the task and cited sources, but the planned checks leave required JSON totals and lower-bound behavior unverified.
